terms.usage: Internal GiraLab game production. Public MP3s are listening demonstrations, not a stock/sample music library. No third-party sample reuse license.
terms.format: Creator sources MP3 44.1kHz 128kbps; reencoding to OGG q6/AAC192/MP3 192 does not restore lost source detail.
terms.seed: null: prompt mode cannot be combined with seed; API did not return a seed. No arrangement randomness.

limitations: Automatic spectral and score checks do not establish musical taste or human listening acceptance.
AAC raw decoder output includes tail padding; exact MP4 edit-list duration is 1,365,677 frames (drop 682,839). FFmpeg-trimmed presentation audio is used for mix/seam tests.
Some short Vorbis hits/fills decode 128 frames shorter in FFmpeg while preserving container duration; short durations remain within their ranges. All looping tracks decode to exact required frames.
8-bar pitched drop follows chord bars 1-8. Engine 2-443 must keep harmonic phase; arbitrary-phase playback has not been approved or verified.
